python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
items=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')]
with open('answers.jsonl','a') as f:
 for r,c in zip(items[90:],['ъъъ','ьъъъ','ъьъъ','ьъ']):
  f.write(json.dumps(dict(item_id=r['item_id'],slots={str(i+1):v for i,v in enumerate(c)},confidence={str(i+1):'high' for i in range(len(c))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918='yes',note=''),ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
answers=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(items)==len(answers)
for r,a in zip(items,answers):
 assert r['item_id']==a['item_id']
 keys={str(i+1) for i in range(r['slots'])}
 assert set(a['slots'])==keys==set(a['confidence'])
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in a['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in a['confidence'].values())
 assert a['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
c=collections.Counter(v for a in answers for v in a['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, and slot coverage:',len(answers),'items;',sum(c.values()),'slots')
print(dict(c))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(a['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for a in answers))
PY
